# Bunting Stage with Microphone — reference review

Two tall side posts and an overhead beam with pennants form a separate stage enclosure around an independently recognizable microphone on a tripod stand.

## Visual draft

A wide overhead stage beam supports three triangular pennants between two tall side posts. A circular microphone on a slender tripod stand occupies the open center below.

## 1. Bunting stage frame (container)

A broad rounded overhead beam spans two tall straight side posts, with three triangular pennants hanging below the beam. Generate the empty stage enclosure and exclude the central microphone and stand.

## 2. Microphone on tripod stand (sub)

A circular microphone head sits on a short angled arm above a thin vertical stand with two spreading feet. Isolate the microphone and stand; exclude the overhead beam, posts and pennants.
